title: Machine config selection and write ownership
text: YOKE_MACHINE_HOME selects its config.json before YOKE_MACHINE_CONFIG_FILE. Relay children discard the inherited config-file override; writers refuse machine_config_not_owned for a foreign config or outside an explicit home. Explicit launch environments may select shared configuration deliberately. Source commands create a disposable machine-home snapshot before import probes; --allow-real-machine-home explicitly permits real writes. Unknown machine-config keys warn once per file/key per process and are ignored, while invalid known values still refuse. Source isolation preserves YOKE_PG_CLUSTER_ROOT and YOKE_PG_BIN_DIR before assigning evidence paths; clusters created inside evidence are destroyed on normal exit, KeyboardInterrupt and SIGTERM. Idle orphan postmasters outside the shared root can be reclaimed with pg_testcluster prune-clusters. Source pruning refuses pgtest_shared_root_unbound when an older runner omits the shared-root handoff; provide the established shared root explicitly before retrying.
